stories.title: HMRC Launches Automatic Making Tax Digital (MTD) Sign-Ups for Sole Traders and Landlords
stories.summary: HMRC has initiated the automatic enrolment of thousands of sole traders and landlords into Making Tax Digital (MTD) for Income Tax this month, marking a significant expansion of the digital tax reporting regime.

stories.title: HMRC Tax Calculation Errors: Contractors Warned to Check Bills as MTD Expands
stories.summary: Warnings have emerged about HMRC overcharging contractors due to tax calculation errors, with experts noting the issue becomes more pressing as Making Tax Digital imposes more frequent submission requirements.

stories.title: 43,000 Illegal Cigarettes and 850-Plant Cannabis Farm Seized in Merseyside Joint HMRC Operation
stories.summary: A joint operation by police, HMRC, and trading standards officers on Merseyside resulted in the seizure of over 43,000 illegal cigarettes and the discovery of an 850-plant cannabis farm, leading to multiple arrests.

stories.title: English Village Piddington Votes to 'Leave UK' in Protest Over Asylum Seeker Housing Plan
stories.summary: Residents of Piddington voted symbolically to leave the UK in protest against government plans to house up to 1,256 male asylum seekers in the area, reflecting growing tensions over Home Office asylum accommodation decisions.

stories.title: Home Office Immigration and Asylum Coverage: Painful Truths About Post-Brexit Immigration
stories.summary: The Guardian reports on continuing analysis of post-Brexit immigration policy impacts, with the Home Office facing scrutiny over its handling of immigration and asylum decisions.

stories.title: UK Joins Multilateral Statement on North Korea's Overseas Labour Programme
stories.summary: The FCDO co-signed a Joint Statement by the Multilateral Sanctions Monitoring Team (MSMT) concerning a report covering the DPRK's overseas labour programme, reaffirming the UK's commitment to enforcing international sanctions.

stories.title: Lord Wood of Anfield Appointed Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State at FCDO
stories.summary: Lord Wood of Anfield has been confirmed as Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State at the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office, following his appointment in July 2026.

stories.title: UK Launches Partnering for Health, Equality and Rights (P4HER) Programme
stories.summary: The FCDO published details of the Partnering for Health, Equality and Rights (P4HER) international development funding initiative, supporting health equity and rights globally.

stories.title: Parliament's Work and Pensions Committee Backs Universal Credit Increase for 66-Year-Olds
stories.summary: The cross-party Work and Pensions Committee has backed calls for the Government to increase Universal Credit for 66-year-olds to prevent hardship as the State Pension age approaches, putting pressure on DWP to act.

stories.title: October 2026 Benefit and Pension Payment Dates Confirmed
stories.summary: DWP has confirmed the October 2026 payment dates for Universal Credit, Pension Credit, Child Benefit, DLA, Attendance Allowance, and Carer's Allowance, alongside cost of living support details.

stories.title: DWP Confirms Completion of Legacy Benefits Migration to Universal Credit
stories.summary: The DWP has confirmed the completion of its migration of all 'legacy benefits' claimants to Universal Credit, with around 24 million people now claiming DWP-administered benefits — approximately one in three people in the UK.

stories.title: DEFRA Releases Full Details of Sustainable Farming Incentive (SFI26) — Window 2 Opens 22 September
stories.summary: DEFRA has released the full details of the reformed Sustainable Farming Incentive (SFI26) scheme, with Window 2 set to open on 22 September, offering farmers funding to enhance water quality and protect natural resources.

stories.title: British Soldier Major Paul Wilks Named After Death in Ukraine Road Accident
stories.summary: The Ministry of Defence has named Major Paul Wilks as the British armed forces member who died in a road traffic accident in Ukraine last week, with tributes paid to his service.

stories.title: Court Martial of Colonel Shepherd and Major Hooks Concludes at Catterick
stories.summary: The MoD and Army have released statements following the conclusion of the court martial proceedings for Colonel Shepherd and Major Hooks at Catterick Military Court, with the Defence Secretary responding to the outcome.

stories.title: Minister Pollard Addresses Defence Industry Collaboration at DVD 2026
stories.summary: Minister for Defence Readiness and Industry Luke Pollard MP delivered a speech at the DVD 2026 event, emphasising the importance of government, industry and private finance collaboration to strengthen British military capabilities.

stories.title: 'Made in Europe' Laws Could Derail UK Plans for EU Reset
stories.summary: New EU 'Made in Europe' regulations are threatening to complicate the UK government's plans for a post-Brexit reset with Europe, raising significant trade policy challenges for BIST and the UK-EU relationship.

stories.title: Dstl Drone Swarm Trial Marks Major Step in UK Army Autonomy
stories.summary: A British Army drone swarm trial delivered by Dstl and industry partners has been hailed as a significant step forward in the UK's autonomous systems capability, advancing the government's defence and science agenda.

stories.title: Union Raises Alarm Over Real-Terms UKRI Science Budget Cuts at TUC Conference
stories.summary: The Prospect union has raised concerns at the TUC conference about real-terms cuts to science budgets by UK Research and Innovation (UKRI), warning that folding science departments could undermine the UK's research capacity.

stories.title: Letby Inquiry Report Condemns 'Scandalously Poor' NHS Management
stories.summary: The Letby inquiry report has delivered a damning verdict on NHS management quality, with The Guardian reporting that the findings make it 'crystal clear' that too much NHS management is at an unacceptably poor standard.

stories.title: NHS Hard FM3 Digital Service Launches to Replace Outdated Hospital Processes
stories.summary: NHS Shared Business Services is launching Hard FM3, a new digital service designed to replace outdated and error-prone facilities management processes in NHS organisations across England, with an introductory webinar set for November.

stories.title: Royal Mail Blasted for Repeatedly Missing Delivery Targets — Ofcom Urged to Act
stories.summary: Royal Mail is facing renewed criticism for repeatedly failing to meet its delivery performance targets, with campaigners and MPs calling on regulator Ofcom to take enforcement action against the postal operator.

stories.title: New Royal Mail Delivery Rules Now in Effect — Saturday Letter Deliveries Removed
stories.summary: Royal Mail's updated delivery rules, including the removal of Saturday letter deliveries (retaining only tracked parcels and Special Delivery items on Saturdays), have now come into effect across the UK.
